Try it:
  kubectl -n helm-demo port-forward svc/api 8080:80
  curl http://localhost:8080/

hooks.name: api-smoke
hooks.manifest:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: api-smoke
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: k8sman-demo
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.27"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: k8sman-demo-0.3.1
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": post-install,post-upgrade
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "5"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 600
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: smoke
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ["sh", "-c", "echo smoke test for api ok"]
